fixed.name: Matthew McConaughey
fixed.why: The front man: calm, empathetic, and talks to everybody. He's argued for independents who can force both parties to work together.

fixed.name: Elon Musk
fixed.why: Funding, a megaphone and industrial-scale know-how. Kept outside government with no say over appointments, so no company writes its own rules.

seats.mission: Help govern and work both sides of the aisle.

candidates.name: Spencer Cox
candidates.bio: Governor of Utah since 2021; chaired the National Governors Association and launched its Disagree Better initiative.
candidates.evidence: Picked by two of the three AIs independently and listed by the third; reelected in 2024, and Utah holds AAA ratings from all three agencies.

candidates.name: Andy Beshear
candidates.bio: Governor of Kentucky since 2019 and its former attorney general; governs alongside a Republican legislature.

candidates.name: Jared Polis
candidates.bio: Governor of Colorado since 2019, former congressman and tech entrepreneur.

seats.mission: Make federal services actually work.

candidates.name: Jennifer Pahlka
candidates.bio: Founded Code for America and was U.S. deputy CTO; helped create the U.S. Digital Service.
candidates.evidence: Helped build the approach to fixing government services that many federal, state and local agencies now use.

candidates.name: Mina Hsiang
candidates.bio: Led the U.S. Digital Service 2021–2025 after working on the HealthCare.gov rescue.

candidates.name: Mikey Dickerson
candidates.bio: Was the hands-on engineering lead of the 2013 HealthCare.gov rescue and became the first administrator of the U.S. Digital Service.

seats.mission: Keep the system stable and growth broad.

candidates.name: Neel Kashkari
candidates.bio: President of the Minneapolis Fed since 2016; ran Treasury's TARP office under Presidents Bush and Obama.

candidates.name: Lael Brainard
candidates.bio: Former Federal Reserve vice chair, Treasury undersecretary and National Economic Council director.

candidates.name: Scott Bessent
candidates.bio: Treasury Secretary since 2025; founded Key Square Capital after years at Soros Fund Management.

candidates.name: Mitch Daniels

candidates.name: Shalanda Young
candidates.bio: OMB director 2022–2025 and former House Appropriations staff director.

candidates.name: Jack Lew
candidates.bio: Former OMB director under Clinton and Obama and former Treasury Secretary.

candidates.name: Marty Walsh
candidates.bio: Former Boston mayor, union leader and U.S. Labor Secretary; now heads the NHL Players' Association.

candidates.name: Julie Su
candidates.bio: NYC deputy mayor for economic justice, former California labor commissioner and acting U.S. Labor Secretary; helped settle the 2023 West Coast ports deal.

candidates.name: Alex Acosta
candidates.bio: Former U.S. Labor Secretary, U.S. attorney and NLRB member.

candidates.name: Byron Auguste
candidates.bio: Co-founded Opportunity@Work and was deputy director of the National Economic Council.

candidates.name: David Autor

candidates.name: Cynthia Breazeal
candidates.bio: MIT professor who leads AI-literacy and workforce programs through MIT's RAISE initiative.

candidates.name: Mark McClellan

candidates.name: Scott Gottlieb
candidates.bio: Physician and FDA commissioner 2017–2019, with a record number of generic drug approvals.

candidates.name: Kody Kinsley
candidates.bio: North Carolina health secretary 2022–2025 who rolled out its Medicaid expansion.

candidates.name: Eric Topol
candidates.bio: Cardiologist and executive vice president of Scripps Research; a leading voice on AI in medicine.

candidates.name: John Halamka

candidates.name: Nigam Shah
candidates.bio: Stanford professor and chief data scientist for Stanford Health Care, deploying clinical AI.

candidates.name: Sal Khan

candidates.name: Luis von Ahn

candidates.name: Kristen DiCerbo
candidates.bio: Chief learning officer at Khan Academy and a learning-science researcher.

candidates.name: Fei-Fei Li
candidates.bio: Stanford professor, founding director of Stanford HAI, creator of ImageNet and co-founder and CEO of World Labs.

candidates.name: Arati Prabhakar
candidates.bio: Former director of both DARPA and NIST and White House science adviser 2022–2025.

candidates.name: Andrew Ng
candidates.bio: Co-founded Google Brain and Coursera; former chief scientist at Baidu.

candidates.name: Elham Tabassi

candidates.name: Laurie Locascio

candidates.name: Arvind Narayanan

candidates.name: Jigar Shah

candidates.name: Chris Wright
candidates.bio: U.S. Energy Secretary and former CEO of Liberty Energy.

candidates.name: Jeff Lyash
candidates.bio: Former CEO of the Tennessee Valley Authority, the nation's largest public power utility.

candidates.name: Daniela Rus
candidates.bio: Director of MIT's Computer Science and AI Lab (CSAIL) and a leading robotics researcher.

candidates.name: Tye Brady

candidates.name: Gill Pratt

candidates.name: Jeff Olivet

candidates.name: Sonny Perdue
candidates.bio: Former Georgia governor and U.S. Agriculture Secretary.

candidates.name: Gina McCarthy

candidates.name: Pam Melroy

candidates.name: Kurt Campbell

candidates.name: Marco Rubio

candidates.name: Preet Bharara

candidates.name: Rod Rosenstein

method: Claude, ChatGPT and Grok each picked blind, on record only. The AI pick is where they agreed; ties went to the strongest concrete evidence.
